_readme: The one source for every event on the site: the homepage hero (featured: true), the homepage 'Upcoming at St. Matthias' cards (everything else), and the /events/ page.
Only public events confirmed on the parish calendar or by the parish office belong here. No bulletins, internal meetings, or special-collection reminders.
Dated events use 'sessions' (ISO 8601 with the Pacific offset: -08:00 in winter, -07:00 in summer). An event disappears from the site after its last session ends.
Recurring events use 'recurrence' and 'time' instead of 'sessions'.
Set 'status' to 'development' only for placeholder events while designing; development events are never published (the build refuses them).
